# Swapnil Shah

> Swapnil Shah is a Backend Developer based in Mumbai, India, working at JM Financial (BlinkX trading platform). He builds Spring Boot microservices serving 500K+ daily active users, plus trading infrastructure, realtime systems and games in Java, Go, Rust and Python.

## Projects
- [Atom Reaction](https://atomreaction.silentkillerop.me): realtime multiplayer chain-reaction game (FastAPI, WebSockets, React, Postgres)
- [Atom Reaction source](https://github.com/swapnilshah10/atomReaction): game repository
- [SilentKillerOp](https://silentkillerop.me): URL shortener and media hub

## Highlights
- Cut the app-init API from 800 ms to 60-70 ms (-92%) for 500K+ daily users.
- Built 15+ Spring Boot microservices with Redis, Kafka, Grafana and Prometheus on GCP.
- Built a crash-resumable order management system, a shared market-data feed hub and a Rust quote store.
